captions.detailed: A compact, black camera speedlight flash with a narrow body and a low shoe mount. The main body features a rear control panel with a small screen and several raised, grey prismatic buttons. Above the body, a swiveling vertical neck holds a U-shaped cradle, which supports a rectangular bounce flash head that tilts on a horizontal hinge. The flash face has a white diffuser lens, and a grey panel rests on top of the head.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a compact travel camera flash. The model should include a narrow main body with a bottom shoe mount, a rear control panel featuring a screen and several small, raised prismatic buttons, and a swiveling neck assembly. The neck must support a tilting rectangular flash head with a front diffuser lens and a top panel, utilizing revolute joints for both the horizontal swivel and vertical tilt articulations.
captions.factory: Construct the camera flash using an assembly of parts. Build the base body using a box primitive, adding a thin plate for the hot shoe and a recessed area on the back. Place several small boxes for the control buttons on the back panel. Model the neck swivel mount using a cylinder and a rectangular block. Create the cradle as a U-shaped yoke using boolean subtractions on box primitives. Finally, construct the main flash head as a box, adding a front white diffuser panel and a top grey plate, and connect the parts with revolute joints for the pan (swivel) and tilt (hinge) axes.
